title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
educational_utility: Foundational pattern recognition for utilizing sorted order to eliminate search spaces monotonically.
common_misconceptions: Incrementing both pointers on sum mismatch
Index off-by-one with 1-based indexing

title: Valid Palindrome
educational_utility: Teaches in-place pointer advancement while skipping non-alphanumeric characters, avoiding auxiliary allocations.
common_misconceptions: Failing to convert to lowercase
Pointer crossover boundary violations while skipping

title: Container With Most Water
educational_utility: Develops proof-by-contradiction intuition: shrinking the width requires moving the shorter bar to have any hope of a larger area.
common_misconceptions: Moving the taller bar
Trying 2D grid DP

title: 3Sum
educational_utility: Crucial interview problem testing duplicate handling across outer and inner loops without extra set allocations.
common_misconceptions: Using std::set to filter duplicates causing O(N^2 log N)
Failing to skip duplicates on left and right pointers

title: Sort Colors
educational_utility: Mastery of strict 3-way pointer invariants (low, mid, high) where mid does not advance when swapped with high.
common_misconceptions: Incrementing index when swapping with high pointer
Falling back to two-pass counting sort instead of one-pass

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
subpattern: Dynamic/Variable Window with Hash Map / Direct Lookup
educational_utility: Classic variable-size sliding window expanding the right pointer and contracting the left pointer upon duplicate detection.
common_misconceptions: Shrinking left pointer by only 1 step instead of jumping past duplicate
Assuming only lowercase letters

title: Maximum Average Subarray I
educational_utility: Canonical introduction to fixed-length window updates: adding incoming element, subtracting outgoing element.
common_misconceptions: Recomputing sum across k elements in an inner loop O(N*k)
Floating point precision truncation

title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
educational_utility: Teaches window contraction while condition is satisfied, finding the minimal valid window length.
common_misconceptions: Assuming array can contain negative numbers where sliding window would fail
Returning 0 when no subarray exists

title: Minimum Window Substring
educational_utility: Cap-stone sliding window problem testing character count validation and tracking valid matched counts.
common_misconceptions: Comparing hash maps on each step O(26*N)
Handling non-matching characters incorrectly during contraction

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
educational_utility: Teaches why sliding window fails when array has negative numbers and how prefix_sum - k lookup solves arbitrary subarray sums.
common_misconceptions: Trying two-pointer sliding window on negative numbers
Forgetting mp[0] = 1 base case for prefix starting at index 0

title: Two Sum
educational_utility: Foundational hash map lookup trading O(N) space for O(1) time complexity.
common_misconceptions: Two passes over map causing self-pairing bugs
Not handling duplicate elements

title: Find Pivot Index
subpattern: Running Left Sum vs Total Sum
educational_utility: Eliminating the need for an explicit prefix array by maintaining a running sum and comparing total - current - left.
common_misconceptions: Allocating two auxiliary arrays for left and right sums
Missing edge index 0 where left sum is 0

title: Binary Search
educational_utility: Fundamental loop invariants: left <= right vs left < right, mid calculation avoiding integer overflow.
common_misconceptions: Using (left + right) / 2 causing integer overflow
Off-by-one with while (left < right)

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
subpattern: Modified Binary Search on Sorted Half
educational_utility: High-frequency interview question: determining which half is normally sorted and checking if target lies within that boundary.
common_misconceptions: Trying to find pivot point first in O(N)
Inequality check missing equality bounds: nums[left] <= nums[mid]

title: Koko Eating Bananas
subpattern: Binary Search on Answer Space (Monotonic Predicate)
educational_utility: Teaches students to identify monotonic decision functions: if speed K works, all K' > K work, converting an optimization problem into binary search.
common_misconceptions: Setting search space to array indices instead of [1, max(piles)]
Integer division truncation in hours calculation

title: Capacity To Ship Packages Within D Days
subpattern: Binary Search on Answer Space (Greedy Capacity)
educational_utility: Reinforces answer-space search boundaries: lower bound is max(weights), upper bound is sum(weights).
common_misconceptions: Setting lower bound to 1 instead of max(weights)
Incorrect day count when current weight fits exactly

title: Find Peak Element
educational_utility: Shows that binary search applies to unsorted arrays whenever a local gradient guarantees the existence of an answer.
common_misconceptions: Linear search O(N)
Comparing mid with both neighbors without handling array bounds

title: Next Greater Element I
educational_utility: Foundational monotonic stack problem demonstrating how unresolved elements wait in a decreasing stack until a greater element arrives.
common_misconceptions: Nested loops O(N^2)
Pushing elements into hash map without resolving previous smaller elements

title: Daily Temperatures
educational_utility: Storing indices instead of values on the stack to calculate distances directly in O(N) total push/pop operations.
common_misconceptions: Storing values instead of indices on the stack
Assuming stack operations inside while loop make it O(N^2)

title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
educational_utility: Essential placement problem teaching how the popped element's height defines the rectangle while the current index and top define boundaries.
common_misconceptions: Computing width incorrectly when stack becomes empty
Failing to flush remaining elements after array traversal

title: Reverse Linked List
educational_utility: Crucial pointer manipulation: maintaining prev, curr, and next pointers without losing track of remaining nodes.
common_misconceptions: Creating new nodes instead of reversing in place
Null pointer dereference on curr->next before saving

title: Linked List Cycle
educational_utility: Classic space-optimization: eliminating hash set of visited pointers using relative speed difference.
common_misconceptions: Checking fast->next without checking fast itself
Using hash table consuming O(N) memory

title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
educational_utility: Idiomatic use of a dummy/sentinel node to eliminate special-case code for the head of the merged list.
common_misconceptions: Memory leak or unnecessary new node allocations
Forgetting to link remaining nodes when one list finishes

title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
educational_utility: One-pass deletion maintaining a gap of n nodes between fast and slow pointers.
common_misconceptions: Two passes (counting length first)
Failing when n equals list length (deleting head) without dummy head

title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
educational_utility: The fundamental tree recursion archetype: 1 + max(depth(left), depth(right)).
common_misconceptions: Missing base case node == nullptr returning 0
Confusing height with node count

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
educational_utility: Queue level-sizing snapshot idiom (int sz = q.size()) to group nodes strictly by level.
common_misconceptions: Pushing children and changing loop size dynamically without snapshotting sz
Pushing null nodes into queue

title: Diameter of Binary Tree
subpattern: Post-Order DFS with Global Maximum Tracking
secondary_patterns: DFS Return Value vs Side Effect
educational_utility: Teaches the pattern where a recursive function returns one metric (height) to its parent while updating another metric (diameter) across the current node.
common_misconceptions: Calling maxDepth separately inside each node causing O(N^2)
Assuming diameter must pass through root

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
subpattern: Valid Range Invariant Propagation (min_val < node->val < max_val)
educational_utility: High-frequency placement question: checking only immediate children is insufficient; ancestral range limits must be propagated.
common_misconceptions: Only checking left < root and right > root
Using INT_MIN/INT_MAX without long long causing overflow when node value is INT_MIN

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
educational_utility: Exploiting BST sorted order: if both p and q are smaller, branch left; if both greater, branch right; otherwise current node is split point.
common_misconceptions: Using generic tree LCA O(N) when BST structure allows O(H)
Recursion without tail-call optimization

title: Number of Islands
educational_utility: The universal standard problem for 2D grid graph traversal and in-place island sinking / visited marking.
common_misconceptions: Stack overflow on deep recursion without sinking cell first
Checking visited after pushing to queue in BFS instead of before

title: Rotting Oranges
educational_utility: Essential multi-source BFS archetype where all initial rotten oranges enqueue at t=0, measuring shortest elapsed time.
common_misconceptions: Running individual BFS for each rotten orange
Incrementing time counter even when no fresh orange rotted

title: Number of Provinces
educational_utility: Introduces adjacency matrix graph traversal and serves as the bridge between standard DFS and Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find).
common_misconceptions: Treating matrix elements as grid cells rather than node-to-node edges
Not visiting all nodes in outer loop

title: Course Schedule
subpattern: Cycle Detection in Directed Graph / Topological Sort (Kahn's)
educational_utility: Prime placement problem for detecting deadlock/cycles in dependency graphs using BFS indegrees (Kahn's Algorithm).
common_misconceptions: Treating directed graph as undirected
Failing to check if processed node count equals V for cycle verdict

title: Clone Graph
subpattern: Graph Copying with Visited Node Hash Mapping (DFS/BFS)
educational_utility: Teaches cycle handling during deep copying by caching cloned nodes in a map: old_node -> new_node.
common_misconceptions: Infinite recursion on cycles without map lookup
Cloning edges before cloning neighbor nodes

title: Network Delay Time
educational_utility: Standard Dijkstra implementation using priority queue with distance relaxation.
common_misconceptions: Using unweighted BFS queue instead of min-heap
Not skipping stale nodes in priority queue

title: Climbing Stairs
educational_utility: The gateway DP problem: identifying overlapping subproblems and reducing O(N) auxiliary space to O(1) rolling variables.
common_misconceptions: Unmemoized recursion causing 2^N TLE
Allocating unnecessary vector<int> when only 2 states needed

title: House Robber
educational_utility: Formulating binary choices: dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i]).
common_misconceptions: Greedy picking largest elements
Off-by-one on base cases for arrays of length 1 or 2

title: Coin Change
educational_utility: Teaches unbounded knapsack state transition with an impossible sentinel value (amount + 1 or INF).
common_misconceptions: Greedy approach picking largest coin (fails for coins=[1, 3, 4], amount=6)
Integer overflow when using INT_MAX + 1

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
subpattern: Subsequence Extension & Patience Sorting (O(N^2) to O(N log N))
educational_utility: Pivotal transition from O(N^2) state checking to O(N log N) patience sorting via binary search.
common_misconceptions: Assuming the tails array represents the actual LIS rather than optimal tail candidates
O(N^2) quadratic checks

title: Longest Common Subsequence
educational_utility: Standard 2D dynamic programming grid problem establishing the base for Edit Distance, Shortest Common Supersequence, and diff tools.
common_misconceptions: Confusing substring (contiguous) with subsequence (non-contiguous)
Base case alignment in 1-indexed DP table

title: Unique Paths
educational_utility: Foundational grid DP: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + dp[i][j-1], reducible to a 1D rolling vector.
common_misconceptions: Full 2D table when only previous row is needed
Combinatorics overflow with large factorials

title: Merge Intervals
subpattern: Sorting by Start Time & Merging Overlaps
educational_utility: Top-frequency interview problem: sorting by start boundary and expanding end boundary whenever intervals overlap.
common_misconceptions: Failing to sort before checking overlap
Using end = interval[1] instead of max(end, interval[1])

title: Non-overlapping Intervals
subpattern: Greedy Interval Scheduling (Sort by End Time)
educational_utility: Teaches classical Interval Scheduling: sorting by end time minimizes overlap opportunities, maximizing non-overlapping intervals.
common_misconceptions: Sorting by start time instead of end time
Removing intervals rather than greedily updating last valid end

title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
educational_utility: Comparing Min-Heap of size K (O(N log K) time, O(K) space) with in-place Quickselect (O(N) average time).
common_misconceptions: Sorting entire array O(N log N)
Max-heap of size N consuming O(N) space instead of min-heap of size K

title: Last Stone Weight
educational_utility: Clean introduction to maintaining sorted maximum elements under dynamic insertions and deletions.
common_misconceptions: Re-sorting array after each stone collision O(N^2 log N)
Failing when heap becomes empty

title: Subsets
subpattern: Cascading Power Set / Pick vs Skip
educational_utility: Foundational backtracking archetype: exploring the include/exclude decision tree with state restoration (push_back / pop_back).
common_misconceptions: Forgetting to pop_back() after recursive call
Passing path by value creating unnecessary copies

title: Combination Sum
educational_utility: Backtracking where the same element may be chosen repeatedly, requiring index persistence and target reduction.
common_misconceptions: Restarting search from index 0 creating duplicate permutations
Failing to prune when remaining sum < 0

title: Generate Parentheses
subpattern: Constrained State Construction (Open vs Close Balances)
educational_utility: State constraints: only place '(' if open < n; only place ')' if close < open.
common_misconceptions: Generating all 2^(2N) strings and validating afterward
Improper balance tracking

title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
educational_utility: Core data structure implementation: TrieNode with child pointers array and is_end_of_word boolean flag.
common_misconceptions: Memory leaks without destructor
Confusing startsWith (prefix match) with search (exact word match)

title: Longest Common Prefix
educational_utility: Vertical character comparison stopping at the first mismatch across all strings.
common_misconceptions: Out of bounds indexing when strings have unequal lengths
Unnecessary sorting of the entire vector

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
educational_utility: Maintaining running minimum buy price to compute optimal sell profit in a single linear pass.
common_misconceptions: Subtracting global min from global max regardless of time order
O(N^2) double loop

title: Maximum Subarray
subpattern: Contiguous Subarray Optimization (Local vs Global Best)
educational_utility: Kadane's algorithm: deciding whether to extend previous subarray or start fresh from current element.
common_misconceptions: Resetting max_sum to 0 (failing on all-negative arrays)
Nested loops O(N^2)

title: Single Number
educational_utility: XOR identity: A ^ A = 0, A ^ 0 = A. Eliminates hash sets entirely.
common_misconceptions: Using hash map O(N) space
Sorting array O(N log N) time
